title: Camps — Fill in: can staff use it after family sign-up has closed?
subtitle: The camp page of a camp whose family sign-up is Closed (Veterans Day Camp), PC 1280. Fill in sits next to Registration link (on phones it is in the header ⋯). By default a camp's family sign-up closes the day before the first day, so a family that walks in on the first camp morning is after the closing date. Families online are not affected by this choice: their form stays closed either way. Amber = the part this choice decides.

columns.label: A · only while sign-up is open

items.caption: A. Fill in works only while family sign-up is open. Closed: Fill in is gray; its tip says to open sign-up first. Problem: opening sign-up opens it for every family online too, and after the closing date only an admin can open it.

columns.label: B · until the camp's last day (recommended)

items.caption: B. Staff and admins can Fill in any time until the camp's last day is over, even when family sign-up is closed (closed by hand or past the closing date). The online form stays closed. After the last day, Fill in is gray: “This camp is over.” Pros: a walk-in on a camp morning is signed up in a minute, by whoever is at the desk. Con: staff can add campers after you closed sign-up on purpose (e.g. the camp is full).

C. Like B, but once family sign-up is closed, only admins can Fill in. Staff see Fill in gray: “The closing date has passed. Ask an admin to fill in for a family.” (the same idea as staff not reopening sign-up after the closing date, v0.725). Pro: you keep control of late adds. Con: a walk-in waits until an admin is there.

footer:
Everything else about Fill in is the same in A, B and C (same form, same prices for today's date, same waiver and signature, duplicate check, “Entered by” you). The screens of Fill in itself come in the next picture.

Recommendation: B — the closing date exists for families online; the desk sees the child in front of them and can decide. If you sometimes close sign-up because a camp is full, pick C.

Your choice: A, B or C?
